about: Parity corpus: answers of the chat redactor at 4c189236 (diagnostics secrets-only rules + chat rules). mask: [input, ...tokens that redactor hid]; sweep: generated inputs (labels x separators x values x contexts, in that loop order; a "{\"" context closes the key with a quote) with the indices into tokens(input) it hid; keep: prose it returned unchanged. Inputs shaped like vendor keys (AWS, GitHub, Slack, OpenAI/Anthropic, Stripe, Google, JWT, PEM) are left out: core's vendor-shape tests own them, and a literal key shape here trips repository secret scanning.
